segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״הִתְקַדְּשִׁי לִי בְּכוֹס זֶה שֶׁל יַיִן״ וְנִמְצָא שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ, ״שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ״ וְנִמְצָא שֶׁל יַיִן, ״בְּדִינָר זֶה שֶׁל כֶּסֶף״ וְנִמְצָא שֶׁל זָהָב, ״שֶׁל זָהָב״ וְנִמְצָא שֶׁל כֶּסֶף, ״עַל מְנָת שֶׁאֲנִי עָשִׁיר״ וְנִמְצָא עָנִי, ״עָנִי״ וְנִמְצָא עָשִׁיר – אֵינָהּ מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: אִם הִטְעָהּ לְשֶׁבַח, מְקוּדֶּשֶׁת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a man said to a woman: «Be betrothed to me with this cup of wine, and it was found» to be a cup «of honey;» or if he said: With this cup «of honey, and it was found» to be a cup «of wine;» or if he said: «With this dinar» made «of silver, and it was found» to be made «of gold;» or if he said: With this dinar made «of gold, and it was found» to be made «of silver;» or if he said: «On the condition that I am wealthy, and he was found» to be «poor;» or if he said: On the condition that I am «poor, and he was found» to be «wealthy, she is not betrothed» in any of these cases. «Rabbi Shimon says: If he misled her to» her «advantage» by giving her something better than what he stated, or if his status was greater than he claimed, she is «betrothed.»

moves.cueHe: התקדשי לי בכוס זה של יין
moves.summary: Any mismatch between stated and actual item or status: she is not betrothed
R' Shimon: if misled to her advantage, she is betrothed
moves.about: whether a betrothal made on a stated item or status that turns out BETTER than stated is valid

edges.about: whether a betrothal made on a stated item or status that turns out BETTER than stated is valid

positions.claim: any deviation from the stated item or status voids the betrothal
positions.basis: the betrothal was conditional on what he stated

positions.claim: if he misled her to her advantage she is betrothed
